name: Washington
summary: A dark green field with the state seal: a portrait of George Washington inside a gold ring reading 'The Seal of the State of Washington 1889'. It is the only US state flag with a green field and the only one depicting an American president.
origin: The flag was adopted in 1923, based on the seal designed in 1889. The portrait was updated in 1967 to one based on Gilbert Stuart's painting of Washington.

symbols.name: George Washington
symbols.description: A portrait of the first president in a gold ring.

facts: It is the only US state flag with a green field.
It is the only US state flag depicting an American president.
The seal's portrait is based on a painting by Gilbert Stuart.
clues: A portrait of a man in a gold ring on dark green.
The only US state flag showing a president.
The only US state flag with a green field.
